title: 1057 Personnel of Police, Fire, Home Guard & Civil Defence and Correctional Services awarded Gallantry/Service Medals on the occasion of the Independence Day- 2026
body_text:
The total of 1057 Personnel of Police, Fire, Home Guard & Civil Defence (HG&CD) and Correctional Services have been awarded Gallantry and Service Medals on the occasion of the Independence Day, 2026. The break-up is as under:-
GALLANTRY MEDALS
Medal for Gallantry (GM) is awarded on the ground of Conspicuous act of Gallantry in saving life and property, or in preventing crime or arresting criminals, the risk incurred being estimated with due regard to the obligations and duties of the officer concerned.
Total 301 Medal for Gallantry (GM) have been awarded. Out of 301 Medal for Gallantry, 272 Police Personnel and 29 Fire Service personnel have been awarded GM respectively.
Among the majority of the 301 Gallantry Awards, 197 personnel from Left Wing Extremism affected areas, 51 personnel from Jammu & Kashmir region, 12 personnel from North-East and 41 personnel from other regions are being awarded for their gallant action.
SERVICE MEDALS
President’s Medal for Distinguished Service (PSM) is awarded for special distinguished record in Service and Medal for Meritorious Service (MSM) is awarded for valuable service characterized by resource and devotion to duty.
Total 92 President’s Medal for Distinguished Service (PSM) have been awarded. Out of 92 PSM, 83 have been awarded to Police Service, 04 to Fire Service, 03 to Civil Defence & Home Guard Service and 02 to Correctional Service.
Total 664 Medal for Meritorious Service (MSM) have been awarded. Out of 664 MSM, 606 have been awarded to Police Service, 28 to Fire Service, 18 to Civil Defence & Home Guard Service and 12 to Correctional Service.

enrichment.summary: On Independence Day 2026, 1057 personnel from Police, Fire, Home Guard & Civil Defence, and Correctional Services were awarded Gallantry and Service Medals. This includes 301 Medals for Gallantry (272 Police, 29 Fire), 92 President's Medals for Distinguished Service, and 664 Medals for Meritorious Service. Among gallantry awardees, 197 were from Left Wing Extremism-affected areas, 51 from Jammu & Kashmir, 12 from the North-East, and 41 from other regions.
enrichment.context: These medals are awarded annually on Republic Day and Independence Day by the Ministry of Home Affairs to recognize acts of bravery and distinguished/meritorious service by police, fire, home guard, civil defence, and correctional services personnel across India. The Medal for Gallantry recognizes conspicuous acts of bravery in saving life/property or combating crime, while the President's Medal for Distinguished Service and Medal for Meritorious Service recognize sustained excellence in service. The heavy concentration of gallantry awards from Left Wing Extremism (LWE) affected areas and Jammu & Kashmir reflects the ongoing internal security challenges in these regions, where police and paramilitary forces face significant risks in counter-insurgency and anti-Naxal operations. This is a routine biannual administrative announcement with no new policy content.
